ss.note: if you have access to weight do goblet squats on the 20 side of reps, if you just have bodyweight go for 40 each set
if you have a gym get some dumbbells and go for 8-10. If not use a couch or bed and do 12-15 each leg
if you are at a gym feel free to sub in and rowing variation (inverted rows, ring rows, single arm DB rows, machine rows) and do 8-12 reps each set
